bio: Daughter of Nicoll Floyd and Tabitha, daughter of Jonathan Smith 2d ([R4-S1]), so a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Jonathan -> Jonathan 2d -> Tabitha -> Ruth, 4 generations: 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Sister of the signer William Floyd and wife of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 465, 486 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
